title: Profinet Plugin updates
description:
Hello all,

I've attached patches for the Profinet Plugin that perform the following changes:

* Decode QualifiedChannelDiagnosis and cleanup diagnosis data decoding
* Correctly name ModuleDiffBlock bits
* Decode ControlBlockPlug
* Update Block Type List according to PN AL Protocol d24MU2 Oct 2020 spec
* Add 10BASET1L MAU Type
* Add APL MAUTypeExtension value
* Decode PDPortDataRealExtended block
* Dissect OwnPort block
* Dissect Neighbors block
* Improve dissecting PDPortDataReal

Please merge :-)

Best regards Dirk Ziegelmeier

(Profinet developer at Pepperl+Fuchs SE, Germany)

notes.body:
Renaming existing fields is a little bit around apon. The reason for that is, that users who relied on those fields, have now an issue with existing filters/profiles. 

Better approach would be to keep the old field but mark it as deprecated via expert info - to be removed in a future version. 

The only exception would be, that the field was not used in the past or it is wrong to be classified as (Qualifiedinfo) in this case.

The main issue here is simply the display filter (pn_io.submodule_state.qualified_info), the rest can change

Hello Roland,

I understand your concern. However, I don't think this is needed here. These two bits are quite obscure, and will become more common in the future. Profinet is evolving to use QualifiedDiagnosis, which was not common before. These bits are only useful together with QualifiedDiagnosis. This is what I currently do at work for our products, and this is why I'm fixing the dissector: It annoys me that I cannot correctly dissect the packets from my device :-)
I really doubt someone is using these two bits in his filters, because they will become meaningful in the future.

It's not that I'm unwilling to fix it! If this is a hard requirement of Wireshark, I'll do something about it!

Best regards
Dirk
Btw, you can use expert info to great avail to mark fields as deprecated, by using PI_DEPRECATED additional to PI_NOTE or PI_INFO
